title: iscellstr
summary: Return true for cell arrays of character row vectors.
description: `iscellstr(C)` returns true when `C` is a cell array and every element is a character row vector.
behaviors: A cell containing only 1-by-N character arrays returns true.
String arrays, string scalars, numeric values, and cells containing non-character values return false.

examples.description: Checking a cell array of character vectors

faqs.question: Do MATLAB string scalars count?
faqs.answer: No. `iscellstr` is the legacy cell-array-of-character-vectors predicate.

gpu_residency: The result is a host logical scalar.
